svg.title: Adithya Sunderrajan - profile.sh --live
svg.desc: Animated terminal profile banner generated from a dithered portrait source image. Generated with Pillow and NumPy. SciPy is unavailable in this Codex runtime, so logo traveller matching uses a deterministic global-greedy shortest-edge fallback.
